description_en: Searches for media asset information such as videos, audio files, and images produced by ApsaraVideo VOD. You can use this operation with the media asset search protocol to perform multi-dimensional searches in ApsaraVideo VOD, including specifying return fields, exact matching, fuzzy matching, multi-value queries, range queries, and sort fields
description_zh: 本接口用于搜索视频点播生产的视频、音频和图片等媒资信息，调用本接口配合媒资搜索协议可实现在视频点播中进行指定返回字段、精确匹配、模糊匹配、多值查询、范围查询、排序字段等多方式多维度的搜索查询
kebab_example: aliyun vod search-media --search-type video --fields Title,CoverURL --match field_=_value --sort-by CreationTime:Desc --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --scroll-token 24e0fba7188fae707e146esa540000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchMedia

parameters.help_en:
The type of media asset to search. Valid values:

video (default): video.
audio: audio.
image: image.
attached: auxiliary media asset.

If this parameter is set to video or audio and you need to traverse all data that matches the search conditions, you must set the ScrollToken parameter
parameters.help_zh:
搜索媒资数据类型。取值范围：

video（默认值）：视频。
audio：音频。
image：图片。
attached：辅助媒资。

当本参数取值为video或audio，且需要遍历搜索条件命中的所有数据时，必须设置ScrollToken参数
parameters.name: search_type

parameters.help_en:
The media asset fields to return in the search results.

By default, only basic media asset fields are returned. You can specify additional media asset fields to return. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99179.html
parameters.help_zh:
搜索结果中返回的媒资字段。

默认只返回基本媒资字段，可指定返回更多媒资字段，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99179.html
parameters.name: fields

parameters.help_en: The filter conditions. For syntax rules, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86991.html
parameters.name: match

parameters.help_en:
The sort field and sort order. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:
CreationTime:Desc (default): sorts by creation time in descending order.
CreationTime:Asc: sorts by creation time in ascending order.

For sort field examples, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99179.html.
When retrieving the first 5,000 records of search results, up to three sort fields are supported.
When retrieving all data that matches the search conditions, only one sort field is supported
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段和排序顺序。多个使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：
CreationTime:Desc（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。
CreationTime:Asc：按创建时间升序。

排序字段示例：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99179.html。
获取搜索条件是前5000条的数据时，最多支持三个排序字段。
获取搜索条件是所有数据时，仅支持一个排序字段
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Default value: 1.

If this parameter exceeds 200, set the ScrollToken parameter as well
parameters.help_zh:
当前页码。默认值为1。

当本参数取值超过200时，建议同时设置ScrollToken参数
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的数据条数。默认值为10，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. The value is a 32-character string.
You do not need to set this parameter for the first search request. When the search request matches data, the server returns this parameter value, which records the current position of the search data. Record the returned value and set this parameter in the next search request based on the following requirements or recommendations:
If SearchType is set to video or audio and you need to traverse all data that matches the search conditions, this parameter is required.
If PageNo exceeds 200, set this parameter to optimize search performance
parameters.help_zh:
翻页标识。长度为32个字符。
第一次执行搜索请求时不用设置本参数。搜索请求命中数据时，服务端会返回该参数值，用于记录当前搜索数据的位置地址。请记录返回的参数值，下一次搜索时按下述要求或建议设置本参数：
当SearchType参数取值为video或audio，且需要遍历搜索条件命中的所有数据时，本参数必须设置。
当PageNo参数取值超过200时，建议设置本参数优化搜索性能
parameters.name: scroll_token

TranscodeMode.description_en:
The transcoding mode. Valid values:

FastTranscode (standard transcoding, default): transcoding starts after the upload is complete, and the audio can be played only after transcoding is complete.
NoTranscode (distribution without transcoding): the audio can be played immediately after the upload is complete without transcoding.
AsyncTranscode (distribution and transcoding upon upload): the audio can be played immediately after the upload is complete, and transcoding is performed asynchronously
TranscodeMode.description_zh:
转码模式。取值范围：

FastTranscode（普通转码，默认值）：上传完成即开始转码，且转码完成才能播放。
NoTranscode（不转码即分发）：上传完成不转码，且立即能播放。
AsyncTranscode（上传即分发并转码）：上传完成即能播放，同时异步进行转码
